# Move background jobs from cron to a queue

This plan moves our cron jobs onto a queue service so jobs retry and scale. One choice is yours: the service.

## Steps

Port the nightly jobs first.

## Question: Which queue service?

- A. Amazon SQS, managed by AWS (recommended)
- B. RabbitMQ on our own hosts
